scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for(const f of ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock']) fs.rmSync(f,{force:true}); if(!process.env.npm_config_user_agent?.startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.verify:prod: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server exec tsx src/verify-e2e.ts
